params.body:
v0.16.0 carries deletion in branch.push (#26), built by the runner from the tag; checksums in SHA256SUMS. The boot script pins the gateway at that sha; `rehearse.sh upgrade` carries the script and reboots.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: The VM at v0.16.0: a push may remove a file
